basis: Gonadal dysgenesis entails impaired gonadal endocrine development; the supplied findings do not establish cardiac or neurologic damage.
Melanoma arising in the posterior uveal tract; distant metastases are not intrinsic organ labels.
Definition specifies carcinoma arising from cutaneous apocrine sweat glands, growing in dermis and subcutis.
Ingested fungal toxins cause gastrointestinal poisoning; additional target organs vary by toxin. Toxin exposure itself is not fungal infection.
Developmental brain abnormalities and skeletal malformations characterize the syndrome; renal hypoplasia 6/6 and hearing impairment 3/3 support involvement.
Carnitine transport disorder; myopathy and hepatic dysfunction annotated 80-99%, cardiomyopathy 2/5. Neurologic crises omitted under the four-axis cap.
Congenital skeletal myopathy with weakness, contractures and scoliosis; associated tremor does not establish separate nervous-system damage.
Muscular dystrophy and cerebral white-matter disease jointly define the condition.
Telomere-related pulmonary fibrosis and marrow failure define the disease; cirrhosis is occasional (5-29%).
B-cell lymphoma qualifies for both blood-cell and lymphoma mechanism axes; other organ infiltration is not established in at least 30%.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability are common across partial 14q duplications; other structural organ abnormalities vary with the duplicated segment.
Definition confines abnormalities to limb bones and joints, with normal intelligence and facial features.
Microcephaly and severe intellectual disability define this neurodevelopmental syndrome; unspecified congenital anomalies do not establish additional axes.
Primary adrenal glucocorticoid deficiency; associated hyperpigmentation does not establish skin injury.
Inherited retinal dysfunction causes stationary night blindness; broad nervous-system ancestry does not establish extraocular neurologic disease.
Lethal skeletal dysplasia with epiphyseal stippling and osteoclastic overactivity; patent ductus arteriosus is annotated very frequent (80-99%).
Osteolysis, dermal/subcutaneous atrophy and metabolic lipodystrophy define the syndrome; hepatomegaly and dental crowding alone do not establish additional organ damage.
Isolated sperm morphology and spermatogenesis disorder causing infertility; no gonadal endocrine failure is established.
Schwann-cell nerve tumor; hearing dysfunction is annotated frequent (30-79%). Scleral tumors represent a rare site-specific subtype, not typical umbrella involvement.
Lethal bone dysplasia; pulmonary hypoplasia and developmental brain abnormalities occur commonly (roughly >=30%) in reported cases; cardiac and renal frequencies are uncertain.
Low-grade neuroendocrine tumor arising in the colon; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Benign vascular neoplasm; its variable anatomical sites do not establish another organ axis for the umbrella concept.
Sarcoma arising in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes; mesenchymal histology does not establish locomotor-system disease.
Inherited T-cell immune dysfunction with recurrent infections; no specific additional organ damage is established as common.
Umbrella of neonatal skeletal dysplasias defined by increased bone density; metabolic or extraskeletal abnormalities of individual subtypes are not shared across the group.
